compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from a recording application. The main content of the screen is a pop-up dialog box asking for location permission. The dialog box reads, "Allow White Noise Free to access this device's location?" with two options: "DENY" and "ALLOW."

Below the dialog box, there is a section titled "SOUND LOCATION" with instructions: "Drop the pin where this sound was recorded. The location will be included if you share this sound with others. It's best to pick a more general location over a private residence."

At the bottom of the screen, there are two buttons: a red "BACK" button on the left and a green "NEXT" button on the right.
